postCreateCommand.installDependencies: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm exec --prefix frontend -- playwright install --with-deps chromium
postCreateCommand.installMdbook: mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && curl -fL https://github.com/rust-lang/mdBook/releases/download/v0.5.4/mdbook-v0.5.4-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz -o /tmp/mdbook.tar.gz && tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/mdbook.tar.gz -C "$HOME/.local/bin" mdbook && printf '\nexport PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"\n' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
